value.name: Dr. Priyanka Jaiswal
value.bio:
Dr. Priyanka Jaiswal, MBBS, MS (Obstetrics & Gynecology), is a distinguished Obstetrician, Gynecologist, IVF Specialist, Laparoscopic Surgeon, and Cosmetic Gynecologist devoted to advancing women’s health through compassion, precision, and innovation. 

She has completed her Fellowship in Laparoscopic Gynecology and Surgery from Kiel, Germany, a globally recognized institute for minimally invasive surgical excellence. In addition, she holds a Fellowship in Microwave Ablation from Hyderabad, specializing in non-surgical management of uterine fibroids and adenomyosis — promoting a “Save Uterus” approach for women’s well-being.

Dr. Jaiswal also holds a Diploma and Degree in Cosmetic Gynecology and has received specialized training in IVF and Reproductive Medicine from Birla IVF Centre, strengthening her expertise in fertility management and assisted reproductive techniques.

In obstetrics, Dr. Jaiswal is highly skilled in normal vaginal deliveries and has extensive experience in managing high-risk pregnancies, including hypertension, diabetes, multiple gestations, preterm labor, and placenta-related complications. She is known for her patient-centered approach, prioritizing safety and comfort for both mother and baby.

In gynecology, she provides comprehensive care for menstrual irregularities, fibroids, ovarian cysts, endometriosis, infertility, and menopausal issues. Her proficiency in laparoscopic and hysteroscopic surgeries ensures minimally invasive treatments with faster recovery and superior outcomes.

As a cosmetic gynecologist, Dr. Jaiswal offers advanced aesthetic and functional procedures to enhance confidence, comfort, and overall quality of life for women.

Combining modern medical innovation with a compassionate approach, Dr. Priyanka Jaiswal is dedicated to empowering women through complete, confidential, and personalized care at every stage of life.

value.name: Dr. K.P Singh
value.qualification: MBBS, MD, MNCCP, MICS (Respiratory Medicine), Dip Card
value.bio:
Dr K. P. Singh, MBBS, MD (Respiratory Medicine), Dip Card, is a senior and highly respected
Pulmonologist with extensive experience in the diagnosis and management of complex respiratory
and critical care conditions. He serves as Senior Consultant - Faculty of Respiratory Medicine &
IRCU at Popular Hospital, Varanasi, delivering advanced, evidence-based care for patients with
acute and chronic lung diseases.
Dr K.P. Singh holds multiple prestigious professional memberships, including MNCCP, MICS, MICAI,
MIES, MERS and FISH (Fellow Indian Society Hypertension) , reflecting his continuous commitment
to academic excellence and advancements in respiratory and intensive care medicine. His clinical
expertise spans the full spectrum of pulmonary and critical respiratory disorders, with a strong focus
on precision diagnosis and patient safety.
He specialises in the management of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), asthma,
interstitial lung disease (ILD), pneumonia, tuberculosis, bronchiectasis, sleep-related breathing
disorders, and respiratory infections. Dr K.P. Singh is also highly skilled in handling acute respiratory
failure, ventilator management, and advanced life support in intensive respiratory care settings.
As part of the IRCU, Dr K.P. Singh plays a crucial role in managing critically ill patients requiring noninvasive
and invasive ventilation, oxygen therapy, and continuous monitoring. His integrated
knowledge of respiratory and cardiac medicine allows for comprehensive care of patients with
overlapping cardiopulmonary conditions.
Known for his calm leadership and patient-centred approach, Dr K. P. Singh emphasises early
intervention, ethical clinical practices, and personalised treatment planning. His dedication to
excellence and compassionate care make him a trusted expert in respiratory and critical care
medicine at Popular Hospital, Varanasi.

value.name: Dr. Md Akhtar Ali Ansari
value.bio:
Dr. Mohd Akhtar Ali Ansari is a skilled orthopaedic surgeon with extensive experience in joint replacement, arthroscopy, spine surgery, and trauma care. He completed his MBBS from Gauhati Medical College, Assam, followed by MS Orthopaedics from the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, where he also served as a Senior Resident in the Department of Orthopaedics.

With more than 6 years of independent experience, Dr. Ansari has performed a wide range of surgeries including hip and knee replacements, arthroscopies for sports injuries, spine surgeries, and complex trauma procedures. His expertise also covers computer-assisted and robotic navigation surgeries, which enhance precision and patient outcomes. He has been actively involved in both elective and emergency orthopaedic care, managing outpatient services and trauma emergencies effectively.

His research work includes a prospective randomized trial comparing medial and lateral pivot knee designs under the guidance of senior faculty at AIIMS, New Delhi. In addition, he is engaged in ongoing studies on pain management in arthroplasty and rare complications in joint replacement. He has contributed to several publications and is preparing case reports and randomized trials for academic journals.

Dr. Ansari has presented at multiple national conferences and attended advanced training programs such as AO Trauma courses, arthroplasty workshops, cadaveric training sessions, and international spine deformity courses. He remains committed to continuous learning and adopts global best practices to refine his surgical skills.

Over his career, Dr. Ansari has independently performed and assisted in hundreds of surgeries, including knee and hip arthroplasties, spine procedures, arthroscopies, deformity corrections, and trauma reconstructions. His strong interest areas include primary and revision arthroplasty, sports injury management, spine surgery, and complex trauma care.

Recognized for his academic achievements, Dr. Ansari has also received awards for excellence during his MBBS and has been an active member of professional societies such as the Delhi Orthopaedic Association and the Indian Orthopaedic Association.

Dedicated to delivering advanced orthopaedic care, Dr. Ansari combines surgical expertise with a patient-centered approach to ensure effective treatment and long-term recovery.

value.name: Dr. Vikas Jaiswal
value.bio:
We are proud to have Dr. Vikas Jaiswal as the Consultant and Head of our esteemed Respiratory Department. With a stellar reputation and a wealth of experience in respiratory medicine, Dr. Jaiswal has dedicated his career to providing exceptional care and treatment to patients with chest diseases.

With an impressive track record of successfully treating over 5 lakh patients, Dr. Jaiswal's expertise and compassionate approach have earned him immense respect in the field of respiratory medicine. His vast experience of 12 years in this specialized area has enabled him to develop a deep understanding of various respiratory conditions and their management.

Dr. Jaiswal's journey in the field of respiratory medicine began with his tenure as a Senior Resident at the VP Chest Institute and RBIPMT in Delhi. Building on his exceptional foundation, Dr. Jaiswal further enriched his knowledge and expertise by serving as a Consultant at prestigious institutions such as Fortis Hospital and Max Super Specialty Hospital in Delhi. These experiences allowed him to work closely with multidisciplinary teams, collaborate on complex cases, and employ the latest advancements in respiratory medicine to deliver optimal patient outcomes.

Beyond his medical achievements, Dr. Jaiswal is known for his warm demeanor, compassionate care, and patient-centric approach. He believes in building strong doctor-patient relationships and takes the time to listen to his patients' concerns, answer their questions, and provide them with personalized treatment plans.

As the Head of our Respiratory Department, Dr. Vikas Jaiswal brings his wealth of knowledge, expertise, and dedication to the forefront of patient care. His leadership ensures that our department remains at the forefront of respiratory medicine, delivering outstanding care to our patients.

He has also been awarded by Dainik Jagaran City Health ICON Award 2022 and Zee News UP Health ICON Award 2022 for distinguished service in the field of Respiratory Medicine field.

We are honored to have Dr. Jaiswal as an integral part of our team and are confident that his expertise and commitment will continue to make a significant impact on the lives of our patients.
